Package com.example.cosmos_discovery.database

Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
com.example.cosmos_discovery.database.AuthService
public class AuthService extends Object
Provides authentication-related operations backed by Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore.

    • isUniversityEmail

      public boolean isUniversityEmail(String email)
      Returns true if the email ends with the allowed university domain.
      Parameters:
      email - The email address to validate.
      Returns:
      True if the email belongs to the allowed domain; otherwise false.

    • isValidPassword

      public boolean isValidPassword(String password)
      Returns true if the password is strong. Requirements: - At least 8 characters - At least one up percase letter - At least one lowercase letter - At least one digit - At least one special character from: !@#$%^&*!?~ - No whitespace characters - Disallows ._()-+=[]{}:;/\| and any unsupported symbols
      Parameters:
      password - The password to validate.
      Returns:
      True when the password satisfies all strength requirements.

    • signUp

      public void signUp(String email, String password, String displayName, Consumer<User> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Registers a new user with Firebase Auth, sends a verification email, and writes the user document to Firestore.
      Parameters:
      email - Must be a university email address.
      password - Plain-text password (Firebase handles hashing).
      displayName - User's full name.
      onSuccess - Called with the new User object on success.
      onFailure - Called with an error message string on failure.

    • signIn

      public void signIn(String email, String password, Consumer<User> onSuccess, Runnable onUnverified, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Signs the user in. Checks that the email is verified and the account is active in Firestore before allowing access.
      Parameters:
      email - The user's email address.
      password - The user's password.
      onSuccess - Called with the User object (including role) on success.
      onUnverified - Called if the email has not been verified yet.
      onFailure - Called with an error message on any other failure.

    • fetchUserDocument

      public void fetchUserDocument(String uid, Consumer<User> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onFailure)
      Reads the user's Firestore document by UID. Used after login to get the role and account status.
      Parameters:
      uid - The Firebase user id.
      onSuccess - Called with the mapped User object.
      onFailure - Called with an error message if lookup fails.

      onFailure - Called with an error message if sending fails.
